discrepancies.claim: To access node:quic, start Node.js with --experimental-quic.
discrepancies.behavior: You also need a build configured with --experimental-quic. Official v24.19.0, v26.13.0 and a default main build accept the flag but throw ERR_UNKNOWN_BUILTIN_MODULE. dtls.md:18-20 documents the build requirement; quic.md does not.

discrepancies.claim: session.opened: validationErrorReason is '' and validationErrorCode is 0 when validation succeeded; validationErrorCode is a {number}.
discrepancies.behavior: On success both keys are absent (undefined). With verifyPeer 'manual' and a failure, validationErrorCode is a string such as 'DEPTH_ZERO_SELF_SIGNED_CERT'.

discrepancies.claim: certs accept ArrayBuffer|ArrayBufferView. The encoding is not stated.
discrepancies.behavior: PEM bytes work. DER bytes (X509Certificate.raw) fail at listen() with ERR_INVALID_STATE 'Failed to create TLS context: Invalid certificate'. PEM strings throw ERR_INVALID_ARG_TYPE.

discrepancies.claim: quic.md says Stability 1.0 (Early development); cli.md --experimental-quic says 1.1 (Active development).
dtls.md says Stability 1.1; cli.md --experimental-dtls says 1 - Experimental.
The dtls.listen() option list omits ticketKeys, but the Ticket keys section passes ticketKeys to listen().
discrepancies.behavior: listen() accepts ticketKeys and requires exactly 80 bytes (ERR_INVALID_ARG_VALUE otherwise).
